values.hypothesis: The enzyme keeps more of its activity at 37 °C with the new buffer than with the standard one.
values.method:
- Samples in both buffers, three repeats each
- Held at 37 °C for 0, 2, 4 and 8 hours
- Activity measured with the standard assay
values.results: With the new buffer, about twice as much activity remained after 8 hours. Repeats agreed closely.

source.title: Buffer effects on enzyme stability, a review

values.summary: Phosphate buffers stabilise many enzymes, but the effect depends strongly on pH.
values.notes: Fits our 37 °C results. Next run, try the new buffer at two pH values to see whether that explains the gain.
